content.text:
The portfolio was compiled and the compiler **rejected** it, as required, because one element of the request cannot be honored:

**Rejection reason — UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST**
- "Change every PicoGreen reaction to 500 µL per well without altering the method name" — registered methods are source-bound and cannot be re-parameterized. Quant-iT PicoGreen (quantit.picogreen.highrange/v2) is compiled at its registered 200 µL microplate format (100 µL pre-diluted sample + 100 µL working reagent, 1:1). This override was preserved in `unsupported_requests` rather than silently substituted, so the compiler refused the graph.

**Everything else in your request was captured faithfully:**
- **GFP (CFXpress)** — 1 sample = 1 positive template + its NTC, 1 reaction each (replicates = 1), 30 °C / 3 h, 488/525 nm, kept registered.
- **Pierce BCA** — 2 unknowns, duplicate (replicates = 2), all 9 registered standards also in duplicate, registered 25 µL sample + 200 µL reagent, 37 °C, 30 min, A562.
- **PicoGreen** — 3 unknowns, single well (replicates = 1), all 4 registered standards in single wells; working reagent and standards human-prepared.
- **Timing** — local workday start 09:00 = t = 0, no separate release offset (release_s = 0), finish by 15:00 → deadline_s = 25200.
- **Budget** — CNY 570 operating budget.
- **Devices** — only device:19 (Fluent 1080), device:18 (Fluent 780), device:67 (SpectraMax iD5), demo:ks4000:1 (KS4000 incubator) and bench enabled; liquid-workstation assembly stays automated (bench used only for manual reagent prep, manual transport and handling).
- **Assumptions** — explicit acceptance of estimated costs, handling durations, digital carriers and layout assumptions passed through as `accept_demo_assumptions = true`.

No device was booked and no hardware was run. To proceed, either drop the 500 µL PicoGreen override (keeping the registered volume), or register/select a PicoGreen method with a 500 µL format — the current catalog has no such method.
